expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (no files created or changed)
The reply identifies path traversal via the file parameter (e.g. ../ or an absolute path makes os.path.join escape UPLOADS)
expectations.evidence: The reply states that "`GET /download?file=../../../etc/passwd` resolves to `/etc/passwd`" and that with `file=/etc/shadow`, `os.path.join` "ignores `UPLOADS` and serves `/etc/shadow`".

expectations.text: The reply names that any logged-in user can read files outside uploads, including other users' files, as the affected boundary
expectations.evidence: The reply says "any file the app's process can read can be downloaded" and that "any caller who knows or guesses a filename can download another user's upload", and it ends with "the path traversal and the missing ownership check are still exploitable by any logged-in user."
